text.card: A red giant 6,321 parsecs away, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.86 solar masses and 22.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,382 K at its surface.
